profiles.notes: GOP-PCERT-1.0 certifies the exact Level-200 Confessor vector as copied branches created only from protected Level-150 masters. GOP-CERT-17 passed; deployment verified.

profiles.role: Standalone Dexterity-primary ranged assassin. Bows, light bows, crossbows, greatbows, ballistas, precision shots, rapid fire, jump/evasive firing and ammunition selection own the encounter; daggers, knives and other light sidearms provide close-range pressure, backstabs, criticals, finishers and escape without becoming the primary loop.
profiles.notes: SM-PCERT-1.0 certifies the exact Level-150 Samurai vector, three protected Journey-1 masters, every ammunition/tool dependency, and the complete ranged-assassin encounter architecture. SM-CERT-17 passed; deployment verified.

profiles.secondaryStat: Requirement-only Strength / Intelligence / Faith; capped Arcane status support
profiles.role: NG+ Dexterity-primary master hunter with complete ranged-armament access, practical Mind and Endurance, multiweapon bow/crossbow/greatbow/ballista states, advanced dagger and rapid-sidearm transitions, deliberate status cycles and a dependable physical ranged baseline. No spells, katanas, sustain loop or conventional melee ownership.
profiles.notes: SM-PCERT-1.0 certifies the exact Level-200 Samurai vector as copied branches created only from protected Level-150 masters. SM-CERT-17 passed; deployment verified.

profiles.role: Standalone Dexterity/Arcane katana-led melee duelist. Fast katana pressure, running and jumping attacks, roll catches, counters, repeated Hemorrhage buildup, Blood/Occult scaling and aggressive repositioning own the encounter. Physical, Lightning, poison, rot, frost, sleep, pierce, strike and stance options prevent bleed dependence. No staff, seal or caster-first loop.
profiles.notes: SR-PCERT-1.0 certifies the exact Level-150 Bandit vector, three protected Journey-1 masters, every equipment/status/resource dependency, and the complete katana-led encounter architecture. SR-CERT-17 passed; deployment verified.

profiles.role: NG+ Dexterity/Arcane blood-duelist capstone with 70 Dexterity, 60 Arcane, practical Mind and Endurance, katana-led pressure, native and infused Blood/Occult weapons, rapid status strings, evasive pursuit and complete non-bleed fallback coverage. Strength remains requirement-only; Intelligence and Faith remain at floor; no spellcasting package is permitted.
profiles.notes: SR-PCERT-1.0 certifies the exact Level-200 Bandit vector as copied branches created only from protected Level-150 masters. SR-CERT-17 passed; deployment verified.

profiles.role: Standalone Dexterity/Faith melee-caster storm warrior. Melee pressure owns neutral; running attacks, pierce counters, charged attacks, stance pressure, jump attacks, roll catches and aggressive repositioning create legitimate Dragon Cult punish windows. Lightning-native and Lightning-affinity weapons remain fully functional when casting is unsafe. Strength is requirement-only; Intelligence and Arcane remain at floor.
profiles.notes: DLC-PCERT-1.0 certifies the exact Level-150 Vagabond vector, three protected Journey-1 masters, every equipment/Dragon Cult/resource dependency, and the complete melee-first storm encounter architecture. DLC-CERT-17 passed; deployment verified.

profiles.role: NG+ Dexterity/Faith storm-warrior capstone with 70 Dexterity, 60 Faith, practical Mind and Endurance, maximum natural Dexterity cast-speed contribution, native Ancient Dragon weapons, Lightning/Keen affinity doctrine, Gravel Stone Seal Dragon Cult punishment and red-lightning finishers. Melee remains primary and casting remains window-driven.
profiles.notes: DLC-PCERT-1.0 certifies the exact Level-200 Vagabond vector as copied branches created only from protected Level-150 masters. DLC-CERT-17 passed; deployment verified.

spellPackages.name: Exploration & Route Clearing
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Heal from Afar; optional Gravel Stone Seal for Lightning Spear
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow before a long segment. Cast resistance buffs only when relevant.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Bestial Vitality is the cheap regeneration substitute; replace a fortification with a boss-specific counter as needed.

spellPackages.name: General Bossing
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Heal from Afar; optional Giant's Seal for Burn, O Flame!
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → chosen body buff. Drink Physick last, then open with the encounter's best damage spell or weapon skill.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Grant Me Strength and Black Flame's Protection are both body buffs and cannot coexist; select offense or physical defense.

spellPackages.name: Melee Reinforcement
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Electrify Armament and Heal from Afar
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → one body buff → Electrify Armament only on a compatible physical weapon.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Electrify Armament cannot buff somber weapons or weapons with elemental affinities; use it on Heavy Greatsword or Bloodhound's Fang.

spellPackages.name: Shield, Deflect & Resistance
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing; no specialist damage seal required
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → exactly one body/resistance buff matching the encounter.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Black Flame's Protection, Barrier of Gold, Flame Protect Me, Golden Lightning Fortification, and Lord's Divine Fortification overwrite one another.

spellPackages.name: Fire & Black Flame
spellPackages.supportTool: Optional Giant's Seal for Giantsflame/Burn; Godslayer's Seal for Black Flame and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Flame, Grant Me Strength → Physick. Use Fire Serpent to force reactions and reserve Burn for large openings.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame Protect Me is a defensive body buff and replaces Flame, Grant Me Strength; do not attempt to stack both.

spellPackages.name: Crucible & Holy Knight
spellPackages.supportTool: No mandatory specialist seal; Crucible armor pieces can provide passive Aspect bonuses
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow. Use Horns or Tail as control tools rather than replacing the weapon's primary damage rotation.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Avoid the entire holy-specialist package against severe holy resistance; retain Stone of Gurranq as the physical fallback.

spellPackages.name: Dragon Cult — Native 31 Faith
spellPackages.supportTool: Hold Gravel Stone Seal in the other hand for its Dragon Cult bonus
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → relevant resistance buff. Use Lightning Spear at range and ADLS only inside secured openings.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Knight's Lightning Spear requires the separate Faith-knot bridge package at level 150.

spellPackages.name: Dragon Cult — Faith-knot Bridge
spellPackages.supportTool: Hold Gravel Stone Seal; Faith-knot Crystal Tear is mandatory
spellPackages.preFight: Drink the Faith-knot Physick before memorized spell use; Golden Vow may be cast before or after drinking because it is already native.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The bridged spell becomes unusable when the Faith-knot expires; never make the package depend on Knight's Lightning Spear after 180 seconds.

spellPackages.name: Large-Bodied Enemy Punishment
spellPackages.supportTool: Gravel Stone Seal for ADLS; optional Giant's Seal for Burn, O Flame!
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Flame, Grant Me Strength. Begin with Pest-Thread Spears or ADLS when several hitboxes can connect.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Use the General Boss package when the target is technically large but does not allow reliable multi-hit contact.

spellPackages.name: Status Cleansing & Resistance
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Heal from Afar
spellPackages.preFight: Use the relevant cure after buildup begins; apply one fortification before entering the encounter's primary damage field.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Cures and fortifications are modular; replace unused elements with offensive spells after the threat is identified.

spellPackages.name: Co-op & Spirit Support
spellPackages.supportTool: Clawmark Seal for Stone/Pest; Gravel Stone Seal for Lightning Spear
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow after allies are inside the aura. Use Heal from Afar proactively, not only after allies disengage.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Great Heal is the close-range group heal; replace one resistance buff when ranged healing is sufficient.

spellPackages.name: Anti-Undead — Intelligence-knot Bridge
spellPackages.supportTool: Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear is mandatory; Clawmark Seal remains the physical fallback
spellPackages.preFight: Drink Intelligence-knot, apply Order's Blade only to a compatible buffable weapon, then use Litany at close range or Discus at range.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The bridge expires after 180 seconds. Somber and elemental-affinity weapons cannot receive Order's Blade.

spellPackages.name: Exploration & NG+ Route Clearing
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing; Gravel Stone Seal for Knight's Lightning Spear
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow before a long segment. Refresh only when the segment length justifies the FP cost.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Replace Divine Fortification with the matching resistance spell when a region is dominated by another element.

spellPackages.name: General Bossing
spellPackages.supportTool: Gravel Stone Seal for lightning; Godslayer's Seal for Erdtree Heal; optional Giant's Seal for Burn
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Flame, Grant Me Strength → Physick. Black Blade is the opener when its maximum-HP reduction is valuable.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Black Blade occupies two slots; remove it for a second defense or utility spell when its opener is not worth the capacity.

spellPackages.name: Melee Reinforcement
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Electrify Armament and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → one body buff → Electrify Armament only on a compatible weapon.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Unique/somber and elemental-affinity weapons cannot receive Electrify Armament; keep Knight's Lightning Spear as the ranged fallback.

spellPackages.name: Shield, Deflect & Maximum Resistance
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Heal from Afar
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → exactly one encounter-matched body/resistance buff.
spellPackages.hardSwap: All five body/resistance options overwrite one another; the package is a menu, not a simultaneous buff stack.

spellPackages.name: Fire, Giantsflame & Black Flame
spellPackages.supportTool: Giant's Seal for Giantsflame/Burn; Godslayer's Seal for black flame and Erdtree Heal
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Flame, Grant Me Strength → Physick. Use Fire Serpent to create movement, then punish with Giantsflame or Burn.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Black Flame Ritual is area denial rather than a universal damage spell; exchange it for Heal from Afar when mobility is more important.

spellPackages.name: Holy, Crucible & Miquellan Rings
spellPackages.supportTool: Optional Dryleaf Seal for Multilayered Ring of Light; Godslayer's Seal for Erdtree Heal
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow. Use Multilayered Ring at range and Crucible Aspects for control/stance pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Holy resistance can invalidate the offensive half of this package; hard-swap to physical, fire, or Dragon Cult instead.

spellPackages.name: Dragon Cult — Complete Native Package
spellPackages.supportTool: Hold Gravel Stone Seal for Dragon Cult damage; use Godslayer's Seal only for healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Physick. KLS is the controlled pressure spell; ADLS/Fortissax/Lansseax are opening-dependent.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The high-commitment red-lightning spells are alternatives, not a mandatory rotation; remove one for Flame, Cleanse Me in status fights.

spellPackages.name: Large-Bodied Enemy Punishment
spellPackages.supportTool: Gravel Stone Seal for lightning; Giant's Seal for Burn; Godslayer's Seal for heal
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Flame, Grant Me Strength. Cast Pest-Thread Spears or ADLS first when multiple hitboxes can be struck.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Use KLS and Stone when the target moves enough to invalidate multi-hit spells.

spellPackages.name: Destined Death & Black Flame
spellPackages.role: Damage Type — Destined Death / Black Flame
spellPackages.supportTool: Hold Godslayer's Seal for black-flame damage; cast Erdtree Heal with Godslayer's Seal
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Black Flame's Protection when physical defense is needed → Black Blade opener → black-flame pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Black Flame's Protection is a body buff and conflicts with Flame, Grant Me Strength and elemental resistance body buffs.

spellPackages.name: Status Cleansing & Resistance
spellPackages.supportTool: Clawmark Seal for Bestial Constitution; no damage specialist required
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → one relevant fortification. Cure buildup only after it becomes meaningful.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Replace unused resistance spells with offense after identifying the exact encounter threat.

spellPackages.name: Co-op & Spirit Support
spellPackages.supportTool: Gravel Stone Seal for KLS; Clawmark Seal for Pest-Thread Spears
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow after allies group. Use Heal from Afar as the primary reactive heal.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Barrier of Gold and Lord's Divine Fortification are mutually exclusive body buffs; pick the encounter's dominant element.

spellPackages.name: Anti-Undead — Intelligence-knot Bridge
spellPackages.supportTool: Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear is mandatory; Clawmark Seal remains the physical fallback
spellPackages.preFight: Drink Intelligence-knot, cast Golden Vow, apply Order's Blade only to a compatible weapon, and use Litany/Discus against undead.
spellPackages.hardSwap: 11 Intelligence + Intelligence-knot reaches 21: enough for Litany, Order's Blade, and Discus, but not Triple Rings of Light.

spellPackages.name: Fire Giant — Physical / Large-Target Counter
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing; Gravel Stone Seal for Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Well-Pickled Turtle Neck → Physick last.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me is the Body Buff; do not also use Flame, Grant Me Strength, Boiled Crab, or Fireproof Dried Liver.

spellPackages.name: Fire Giant — Physical / Large-Target Counter
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade / healing; Gravel Stone Seal for ADLS
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Well-Pickled Turtle Neck → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me replaces every other Body Buff. Black Blade is the phase-two opener when a safe cast exists.

spellPackages.name: Radagon — Fire / Holy-Defense Counter
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Radagon of the Golden Order
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Flame / healing; optional Giant's Seal for Burn, O Flame!
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Lord's Divine Fortification → Physick. Use fire and physical attacks after teleports and hammer recoveries.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Lord's Divine Fortification is the safe Body Buff. Replace it with Flame, Grant Me Strength only for a learned maximum-damage attempt.

spellPackages.name: Radagon — Fire / Holy-Defense Counter
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Radagon of the Golden Order
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for black flame / healing; Giant's Seal for Giantsflame/Burn
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Lord's Divine Fortification → Physick. Open with fire pressure, then punish recovery with melee.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The safe version uses Lord's Divine Fortification and Opaline; the learned version uses Flame, Grant Me Strength and Stonebarb.

spellPackages.name: Elden Beast — Physical / Pest-Thread / Holy-Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing / Black Flame; Gravel Stone Seal only for ADLS
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Lord's Divine Fortification → Physick. Mount Torrent after large retreats and dismount for close Pest-Thread casts.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Do not use holy offense. Lord's Divine Fortification replaces every offensive Body Buff.

spellPackages.name: Elden Beast — Physical / Destined Death / Holy-Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade / Black Flame / healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Lord's Divine Fortification → Physick. Use Black Blade once, then Pest-Thread Spears and physical melee.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Do not use holy offense or status plans; both are poor or invalid here.

spellPackages.name: Rykard — Serpent-Hunter & Fire Defense
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Well-Pickled Turtle Neck → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me is the Body Buff; Serpent-Hunter remains the actual damage solution.

spellPackages.name: Rykard — Serpent-Hunter & Fire Defense
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade, Black Flame, and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Well-Pickled Turtle Neck → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me replaces every other Body Buff; do not spend the package on offensive casting while the Serpent-Hunter window is available.

spellPackages.name: Astel — Large Target & Magic Defense
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
spellPackages.supportTool: Gravel Stone Seal for Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike; Godslayer's Seal for healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Barrier of Gold → Physick. Cast Pest-Thread Spears only when several body segments can connect.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Barrier of Gold replaces offensive Body Buffs. Stop casting when Astel begins a teleport or gravity grab.

spellPackages.name: Astel — Large Target & Magic Defense
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade and healing; Gravel Stone Seal for ADLS
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Barrier of Gold → Physick. Use Black Blade once and Pest-Thread Spears beneath the body.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Barrier of Gold is the Body Buff. Save stamina and camera control for teleport grabs.

spellPackages.name: Mohg — Nihil, Bloodflame & Physical Pressure
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Mohg, Lord of Blood
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Purifying Physick. Use Mohg's Shackle twice before phase 2.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Purifying Crystal Tear is mandatory. Flame, Protect Me is the safe Body Buff; replace it with Flame, Grant Me Strength only for a learned attempt.

spellPackages.name: Mohg — Nihil, Bloodflame & Destined Death
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Mohg, Lord of Blood
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade, Black Flame, and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Purifying Physick. Open phase 1 with Black Blade if safe.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Purifying Crystal Tear is mandatory. Flame, Protect Me replaces every offensive Body Buff.

spellPackages.name: Placidusax — Mixed Element & Ancient Dragon
spellPackages.supportTool: Gravel Stone Seal for ADLS; Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → choose Flame, Protect Me or Golden Lightning Fortification → Well-Pickled Turtle Neck → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me and Golden Lightning Fortification are native Level 150 Body Buff alternatives and overwrite one another. Choose the dominant incoming element.

spellPackages.name: Placidusax — Mixed Element, Ancient Dragon & Destined Death
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade / healing; Gravel Stone Seal for ADLS
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Protection of the Erdtree → Physick. Use Black Blade once, then Pest-Thread Spears.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Protection of the Erdtree is the Body Buff; switch to Golden Lightning Fortification only if lightning is the sole failure point.

spellPackages.name: Dancing Lion — Rotating Element Defense
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Divine Beast Dancing Lion
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing; phase-matched Fortification is the active Body Buff
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → the phase-matched Fortification → Well-Pickled Turtle Neck → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Magic, Lightning, and Flame Fortification overwrite one another; recast only after a clear phase transition.

spellPackages.name: Dancing Lion — Mixed Element Defense
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Divine Beast Dancing Lion
spellPackages.supportTool: Gravel Stone Seal for ADLS; Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Protection of the Erdtree → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Protection of the Erdtree is the default Body Buff; switch to a greater single-element Fortification only when one phase is the consistent failure point.

spellPackages.name: Rellana — Magic / Fire Defense & Stance Support
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Barrier of Gold for phase 1; replace with Flame, Protect Me only if phase-two fire is the failure point.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Barrier of Gold and Flame, Protect Me are mutually exclusive Body Buffs. Never attempt both simultaneously.

spellPackages.name: Rellana — Complete Mixed Defense
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Protection of the Erdtree → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Protection of the Erdtree is the default Body Buff. Barrier of Gold or Flame, Protect Me are stronger single-element hard swaps.

spellPackages.name: Putrescent Knight — Holy / Magic Counter
spellPackages.supportTool: Crucible armor bonuses support the selected Aspects; Godslayer's Seal for healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Magic Fortification → Holy-Shrouding Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Magic Fortification is the Body Buff. Thawfrost Boluses handle Frostbite and do not occupy a buff category.

spellPackages.name: Putrescent Knight — Miquellan Holy Counter
spellPackages.supportTool: Dryleaf Seal may be held for Multilayered Ring of Light; Godslayer's Seal for healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Magic Fortification → Holy-Shrouding Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Magic Fortification is the Body Buff. Keep Thawfrost Boluses ready rather than replacing the offensive package.

spellPackages.name: Midra — Frenzy / Fire Defense & Slash Support
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Well-Pickled Turtle Neck → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me is the Body Buff. Clarifying Boluses and Focus gear manage Madness without replacing it.

spellPackages.name: Midra — Frenzy / Fire Defense & Destined Death
spellPackages.role: Specific Boss — Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade, Black Flame, and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Physick. Use Black Blade only during the transformation recovery.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me is the Body Buff. Do not replace it with Howl of Shabriri in a first-clear attempt.

spellPackages.name: Messmer — Physical / Holy Pressure & Fire Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Crucible armor supports Aspects; Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me is the Body Buff. The offensive plan is physical/holy, not fire.

spellPackages.name: Messmer — Holy / Destined Death & Fire Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Dryleaf Seal for Multilayered Ring; Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade / healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me is the Body Buff. Use Black Blade or Multilayered Ring only after long spear or serpent recoveries.

spellPackages.name: Bayle — Dragonwound & Mixed Fire / Lightning Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me or Golden Lightning Fortification → Dragonwound Grease → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The two elemental Fortifications are mutually exclusive. Use Flame, Protect Me by default and switch only when lightning is the clear failure point.

spellPackages.name: Bayle — Dragonwound, Destined Death & Mixed Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade / healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Protection of the Erdtree → Dragonwound Grease → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Protection of the Erdtree is the default Body Buff. Flame, Protect Me is the single-element hard swap.

spellPackages.name: Promised Consort — Gravity / Holy Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Barrier of Gold for phase 1; Lord's Divine Fortification before or during phase 2 when safe.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Barrier of Gold and Lord's Divine Fortification overwrite one another. The phase-two holy buff takes priority.

spellPackages.name: Promised Consort — Gravity, Holy & Destined Death
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade, Black Flame, and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Barrier of Gold for phase 1; Lord's Divine Fortification takes priority in phase 2.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The two greater Fortifications are mutually exclusive. Do not interrupt a safe guard-counter rhythm to recast during an active combo.

spellPackages.name: Godskin — Sleep Control & Black-Flame Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing; the damage plan remains physical rather than fire
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Physick → apply Sleep with a pot or arrow.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me is the Body Buff. Wide attacks must not wake a sleeping second target.

spellPackages.name: Godskin — Sleep Control, Black Flame & Destined Death
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade, Black Flame, and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Flame, Protect Me → Physick → Sleep tool.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me is the Body Buff. Black Blade is optional and must not wake an isolated sleeping target.

spellPackages.name: Dragon Hunt — Dragonwound & Element Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame; Gravel Stone Seal is not used for offensive lightning against Ancient Dragons
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → phase-matched Fortification → Dragonwound Grease → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me and Golden Lightning Fortification overwrite one another. Choose the dragon's dominant element.

spellPackages.name: Dragon Hunt — Dragonwound, Destined Death & Mixed Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade, Black Flame, and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Protection of the Erdtree → Dragonwound Grease → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Protection of the Erdtree is the default Body Buff; use a greater single-element Fortification only for a known variant.

spellPackages.name: Fallingstar Beast — Gravity Defense & Physical Stance
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing; weapon damage remains physical/strike
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Barrier of Gold → Stonebarb Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Barrier of Gold is the Body Buff. Do not commit to casting during a gravity-lift startup.

spellPackages.name: Fallingstar Beast — Gravity Defense, Physical Stance & Destined Death
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Barrier of Gold → Physick. Use Black Blade only after a beam or charge recovery.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Barrier of Gold is the Body Buff. Fallingstar Beast Jaw is a weapon hard swap, not a spell requirement.

spellPackages.name: Erdtree Corruption — Fire Offense, Holy Defense & Cleansing
spellPackages.role: Specialist Encounter — Tree Spirits / Erdtree Avatars
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Lord's Divine Fortification for safety or Flame, Grant Me Strength for offense → Flame Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The holy-defense and offensive Body Buffs overwrite one another. Putrid variants require Preserving Boluses or Flame, Cleanse Me.

spellPackages.name: Erdtree Corruption — Fire, Destined Death, Holy Defense & Cleansing
spellPackages.role: Specialist Encounter — Tree Spirits / Erdtree Avatars
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade, Black Flame, and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Lord's Divine Fortification or Flame, Grant Me Strength → Flame Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Choose exactly one Body Buff. Black Blade is reserved for high-HP late-game variants.

spellPackages.name: Dragonkin — Frozen Lightning & Large-Target Counter
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing; the offensive plan remains physical/Pest-Thread rather than lightning
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Golden Lightning Fortification → Physick. Keep Thawfrost Boluses ready.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Golden Lightning Fortification is the Body Buff. Do not use offensive lightning against the lightning-resistant target.

spellPackages.name: Dragonkin — Frozen Lightning, Destined Death & Large-Target Counter
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Golden Lightning Fortification → Physick. Use Black Blade once after a failed slam.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Golden Lightning Fortification is the Body Buff; preserve Thawfrost Boluses for Frostbite.

spellPackages.name: Royal Revenant — Healing Damage & Stance Break
spellPackages.supportTool: Clawmark Seal physical fallback; pure-Faith seal is required for the strongest healing damage
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Boiled Crab → Physick. Cast Great Heal or Heal from Afar directly into the Revenant.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Healing incantations are the primary damage tool. Do not waste the opening on weapon buffs.

spellPackages.name: Royal Revenant — Erdtree Healing Damage & Stance Break
spellPackages.supportTool: Clawmark Seal physical fallback
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Boiled Crab → Physick. Use Erdtree Heal at close range for the primary punish.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Erdtree Heal is the strongest native healing attack; retain Heal from Afar for safer spacing.

spellPackages.name: Jori — Summon Clearing & Holy Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Gravel Stone Seal for Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike; Godslayer's Seal for healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Lord's Divine Fortification → Physick. Save area spells for the summoned mob wave.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Lord's Divine Fortification is the Body Buff. Prioritize Jori whenever the summons are not body-blocking.

spellPackages.name: Jori — Summon Clearing, Destined Death & Holy Defense
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade and healing; Gravel Stone Seal for ADLS
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Lord's Divine Fortification → Physick. Open with Black Blade if Jori is exposed.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Do not cast Black Blade into a body-blocking summon; use area spells to clear the lane first.

spellPackages.name: Lamenter — Clone Elimination & Area Burst
spellPackages.supportTool: Gravel Stone Seal for ADLS; Giant's Seal may support Giants' Flame spells
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Flame, Grant Me Strength → Physick. Save area spells for each clone cycle.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Clone elimination takes priority over boss damage; do not spend every area spell before the duplication mechanic begins.

spellPackages.name: Lamenter — Clone Elimination, Wrath & Area Burst
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade/healing; Gravel Stone Seal for ADLS
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Flame, Grant Me Strength → Physick. Reserve Wrath of Gold for clone spawns.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The instant-loss clone mechanic takes priority over maximum-DPS casting.

spellPackages.name: Death Knight — Lightning Defense & Grab Punish
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for healing and Black Flame
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → Golden Lightning Fortification → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Golden Lightning Fortification is the Body Buff. Preserve stamina to evade the life-stealing grab.

spellPackages.name: Death Knight — Lightning Defense, Destined Death & Grab Punish
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal for Black Blade and healing
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Golden Lightning Fortification → Physick. Use Black Blade only after a missed grab or long axe recovery.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Golden Lightning Fortification is the Body Buff; Lord's Divine Fortification is a variant hard swap, not an additional buff.

spellPackages.name: Exploration & Route Clearing
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal only after obtaining another copy in a later journey
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow before a long route segment. Use Dragonclaw or Catch Flame for fast pressure; save full breaths for grouped enemies or safe ranged openings.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Swap the elemental breath to match resistance. The five damage types are a menu, not a required rotation.

spellPackages.name: General Bossing — Dragon Debuff & Punish
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal only after obtaining another copy in a later journey
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → selected body buff if used → Physick. Apply Greyoll's Roar only inside a safe opening, then convert recovery windows with Dragonmaw.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Greyoll's Roar occupies two slots and is an enemy debuff. Replace Theodorix's Magma or Ghostflame Breath when the target strongly resists that damage type.

spellPackages.name: Complete Elemental Breath Menu
spellPackages.role: Damage Type — Fire / Magic / Frost / Rot / Magma
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal only after obtaining another copy in a later journey
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Choose one primary breath based on resistance and use Greyoll's Roar only when its two-slot debuff is worth the commitment.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Do not channel every breath in one fight. Smarag, Borealis, Ekzykes, and Theodorix are specialist hard swaps selected for damage type or status.

spellPackages.name: Rot, Frost, Poison & Hemorrhage Control
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal only after obtaining another copy in a later journey
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Apply only the statuses the target can receive; use Greyoll's Roar before long status channels when safe.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Status immunity overrides package rank. Replace redundant rot or frost variants with healing or a defense spell against immune targets.

spellPackages.name: Sanguine Dragon Communion Module
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal only after obtaining another copy in a later journey
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Begin with Swarm of Flies or Furious Blade to create movement pressure, then punish commitment with Dragonmaw.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Bloodflame Blade is excluded until the weapon audit identifies a buffable physical weapon; Occult and elemental affinities cannot receive it.

spellPackages.name: Bayle's Flame Lightning Path
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal only after obtaining another copy in a later journey
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Apply Greyoll's Roar on a secured opening, then use Bayle's Flame Lightning only after a long recovery or stance break.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Requires choosing Bayle's Flame Lightning from the Heart of Bayle. Bayle's Tyranny is unavailable on this journey unless already acquired in a prior journey.

spellPackages.name: Bayle's Tyranny Path
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal only after obtaining another copy in a later journey
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Use Dragonclaw or Dragonmaw for ordinary pressure and reserve Bayle's Tyranny for grouped enemies or a secured point-blank opening.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Requires choosing Bayle's Tyranny from the Heart of Bayle. Bayle's Flame Lightning is unavailable on this journey unless already acquired in a prior journey.

spellPackages.name: Dragon Communion Defense & Recovery
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal only after obtaining another copy in a later journey
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing's Boon → Golden Vow → exactly one matching body or resistance buff → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Protect Me, Golden Lightning Fortification, Lord's Divine Fortification, and Barrier of Gold overwrite one another; memorize the menu but cast only one.

spellPackages.name: Exploration & NG+ Route Clearing
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal after NG+ for maximum school-passive stacking
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow before a long route segment. Use Dragonclaw for fast pressure and reserve Dragonmaw or full breaths for secured openings.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Elemental and status breaths remain matchup swaps. The two-slot regeneration spell is included because Level 200 has the Faith and FP budget to sustain it.

spellPackages.name: General Bossing — Dragon Debuff, Stance & Large-Body Punish
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal after NG+ for maximum school-passive stacking
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Apply Greyoll's Roar when safe, use Dragonmaw for stance pressure, and switch to Pest-Thread Spears only when a large body allows repeated hits.
spellPackages.hardSwap: This journey-neutral package deliberately excludes both Heart of Bayle rewards. Replace Theodorix's Magma or Pest-Thread Spears when the matchup invalidates them.

spellPackages.name: Complete Elemental Breath Menu
spellPackages.role: Damage Type — Fire / Magic / Frost / Rot / Magma
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal after NG+ for maximum school-passive stacking
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Select the breath matching the enemy's lowest relevant resistance and use Greyoll's Roar only when the debuff window is safe.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Named breaths are alternatives, not a single rotation. Replace one specialist with Flame, Cleanse Me for hazardous areas.

spellPackages.name: Advanced Rot, Frost & Hemorrhage Control
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal after NG+ for maximum school-passive stacking
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Apply Greyoll's Roar before committed status channels only when the target is vulnerable and the opening is secure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Rotten Butterflies is a close-area alternative, not a replacement for the efficient Rotten Breath opener. Remove status spells against immune targets.

spellPackages.name: Sanguine Dragon Communion Module
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal after NG+ for maximum school-passive stacking
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Use Swarm or Furious Blade to force movement, Bloodboon or Talons for area denial, and Dragonmaw for the committed punish.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Bloodflame Blade remains outside the exact package until a buffable physical weapon is deliberately selected; the default Occult weapon will not accept it.

spellPackages.name: Bayle's Flame Lightning Path
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal after NG+ for maximum school-passive stacking
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Greyoll's Roar establishes the debuff; Bayle's Flame Lightning follows a stance break, knockdown, or long recovery.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Requires the Flame Lightning reward. Tyranny remains a separate package because the Heart of Bayle cannot provide both rewards in one journey.

spellPackages.name: Bayle's Tyranny Path
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal after NG+ for maximum school-passive stacking
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Reserve Tyranny for a secured point-blank AoE window; use the melee dragon casts for ordinary punish cycles.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Requires the Tyranny reward. Flame Lightning remains a separate package because the Heart of Bayle cannot provide both rewards in one journey.

spellPackages.name: Dragon Communion Maximum Defense & Recovery
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal after NG+ for maximum school-passive stacking
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → exactly one matching body or resistance buff → Physick.
spellPackages.hardSwap: All five resistance/body options are mutually exclusive. Barrier of Gold can be replaced by Black Flame's Protection against primarily physical encounters.

spellPackages.name: Placidusax's Ruin — Three-Slot Spectacle Reserve
spellPackages.supportTool: Godslayer's Seal +25 for direct healing; optional second Dragon Communion Seal after NG+ for maximum school-passive stacking
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Physick. Apply Greyoll's Roar only if the opening permits, then reserve Placidusax's Ruin for a stagger, knockdown, or scripted recovery.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Placidusax's Ruin consumes three slots and does not receive the Dragon Communion Seal's school bonus. It is a dedicated reserve package, not the general boss default.

spellPackages.name: Moonlit Consort — Ranni Bridge
spellPackages.supportTool: Carian Glintstone Staff +25 for sword sorceries; Carian Glintblade Staff +25 for phalanx/glintblade spells — one support hard swap at a time
spellPackages.preFight: Magic-Shrouding + Intelligence-knot Physick → Ranni's Dark Moon → activate Moonlight Greatsword → charged beam or Carian melee punish.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Ranni requires the Intelligence-knot bridge at Level 150. Swap the support staff by spell school; carry only one support staff with Carian Regal Scepter.

spellPackages.name: Nightblade Pressure — Level 150
spellPackages.supportTool: Staff of Loss +25 held for Night Comet; no-penalty Carian Regal casting for the rest of the package
spellPackages.preFight: Greatblade Phalanx → Terra Magica only when the target will remain inside → Physick → Night Comet / Comet / Shard Spiral or Moonlight Greatsword pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Staff of Loss must remain visibly held for the 30% Night Comet bonus. Drop Terra Magica against mobile targets and Scholar's Shield when no shield is equipped.

spellPackages.name: Royal Shadow — Blaidd & Ranni
spellPackages.supportTool: Carian Knight's Shield +25 for Scholar's Shield; no passive-support staff in the active fashion package
spellPackages.preFight: Magic-Shrouding + Intelligence-knot Physick → Ranni's Dark Moon → Scholar's Shield only when the shield is active → Royal Greatsword pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Ranni requires Intelligence-knot at Level 150. The shield and Dark Moon Greatsword are menu swaps; do not exceed the certified Fashion equip-load rule.

spellPackages.name: Twin Moon Champion
spellPackages.supportTool: Carian Glintstone Staff +25 for sword sorceries; Carian Glintblade Staff +25 for phalanx/glintblade spells — one support hard swap at a time
spellPackages.preFight: Ranni's Dark Moon → activate Moonlight Greatsword → use Rellana's Twin Moons only during a fully secured commitment window → rotate Carian melee and beam pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Both moon sorceries are native at 80 Intelligence. Rellana's Twin Moons is spectacle/area commitment, not the default punish; choose one Carian support staff by spell school.

spellPackages.name: Maximum Moon & Night Burst
spellPackages.primaryTool: Lusat's Glintstone Staff +10 for burst; Carian Regal Scepter +10 no-penalty swap
spellPackages.supportTool: Staff of Loss +25 held for Night Comet
spellPackages.preFight: Terra Magica when stationary → Physick → selected Lusat burst. Use Staff of Loss for Night Comet and Carian Regal Scepter when FP efficiency matters.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Lusat raises individual sorcery FP costs by 50%. The baseline one-each audit excludes that penalty; do not use Lusat as the exploration default.

spellPackages.name: Royal Shadow Capstone
spellPackages.supportTool: Carian Knight's Shield +25 menu hard swap; no passive-support staff in the active fashion package
spellPackages.preFight: Ranni's Dark Moon → use Rellana's Twin Moons only for a deliberate spectacle opening → Royal Greatsword / Carian melee follow-up.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Both moons are native. Shield and Dark Moon Greatsword remain menu swaps to preserve the certified 69.3% Fashion load.

spellPackages.name: Starscourge Gravity Arena
spellPackages.supportTool: Meteorite Staff held in the offhand during gravity-sorcery casting; hard swap back to the paired Starscourge Greatsword before melee
spellPackages.preFight: Magic-Shrouding + Intelligence-knot Physick → Academy Staff main hand / Meteorite Staff offhand → Collapsing Stars or Gravitational Missile → hard swap to Starscourge Greatsword → Starcaller Cry.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Intelligence-knot raises 30→40 for Collapsing Stars and Gravitational Missile. The staff pair and Starscourge Greatsword are separate casting/melee states; do not count them as simultaneous active weight.

spellPackages.name: Ruins Shockwave & Stance Control
spellPackages.supportTool: Meteorite Staff held for gravity casts; return to two-handed Ruins Greatsword or the Great Stars strike swap before weapon pressure
spellPackages.preFight: Intelligence-knot + Stonebarb Physick → Greatblade Phalanx or Gravitational Missile → Terra Magica only if the target will remain inside → Wave of Destruction.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The 36-INT spells require Intelligence-knot. Terra Magica is conditional, Scholar's Shield is inactive without a shield swap, and Meteorite is restricted to large or trapped targets.

spellPackages.name: Fallingstar Arena Control
spellPackages.supportTool: Meteorite Staff gravity-support hard swap; return to the two-handed Fallingstar Beast Jaw for the visible arena presentation
spellPackages.preFight: Intelligence-knot + Opaline Physick → Gravity Well or Collapsing Stars → Gravity Bolt pressure → Meteorite only during a fully secured large-target window.
spellPackages.hardSwap: The 36-INT control spells require Intelligence-knot. Scholar's Shield is a menu reserve for a shield variant and is not part of the visible two-handed Fashion state.

spellPackages.name: Prime Radahn & Astel Gravity
spellPackages.supportTool: Meteorite Staff held during gravity casting; hard swap back to Starscourge Greatsword for Starcaller Cry and paired-colossal follow-up
spellPackages.preFight: Magic-Shrouding + Intelligence-knot Physick → Gravitational Missile → Starcaller Cry. Use Meteorite of Astel only against a trapped large body or a fully scripted recovery.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Intelligence-knot raises 48→58 for Meteorite of Astel. Blades of Stone uses one memory slot; Meteorite of Astel uses two. Scholar's Shield is active only with the Redmane Greatshield swap.

spellPackages.name: Maximum Ruins Gravity Burst
spellPackages.supportTool: Meteorite Staff held for gravity spells; return to two-handed Ruins Greatsword or Heavy Great Stars before the weapon punish
spellPackages.preFight: Terra Magica only when stable → Magic-Shrouding + Bloodsucking Physick → Gravitational Missile or charged Blades of Stone → Wave of Destruction.
spellPackages.hardSwap: All equipped spells are native at 48 INT. This package intentionally excludes Meteorite of Astel so the maximum-damage Physick can omit Intelligence-knot. Replace Bloodsucking with Opaline for first clears.

spellPackages.name: Rotten Duelist Cosmic Spectacle
spellPackages.supportTool: Meteorite Staff gravity-support hard swap; return to the two-handed Fallingstar Beast Jaw for the visible Rotten Duelist state
spellPackages.preFight: Intelligence-knot + Opaline Physick → Gravity Well or Gravitational Missile → Gravity Bolt pressure. Reserve Meteorite of Astel for a deliberate arena spectacle window.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Intelligence-knot raises 48→58 for Meteorite of Astel. Blades of Stone uses one slot and Meteorite of Astel uses two. Greatblade Phalanx and Shard Spiral preserve stance and large-body fallbacks.

spellPackages.name: Primeval Current Burst — Level 150
spellPackages.supportTool: Azur's Glintstone Staff +10 cast-speed hard swap; Death's Poker and Wing of Astel are separate weapon states
spellPackages.preFight: Terra Magica only in a stable window → Magic-Shrouding + Cerulean Hidden Physick → Comet Azur or primeval-current barrage.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Baseline audit excludes Lusat's 50% staff penalty, Lusat crown's 15% global FP penalty, and Comet Azur channel ticks. Use Azur only when cast speed is worth its 20% staff penalty.

spellPackages.name: Night Generalist — Level 150
spellPackages.supportTool: Staff of Loss +25 must be held for Night Comet; Death's Poker and Wing of Astel remain weapon-skill states
spellPackages.preFight: Ranni's Dark Moon when the debuff/frost opener is worth the cast → Staff of Loss Night Comet → Shard Spiral, gravity, or weapon-skill punish.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Staff of Loss must remain visibly held for its 30% Night Comet bonus. Terra Magica is conditional; Rock Sling and Gravitational Missile receive no Meteorite Staff bonus in this exact loadout.

spellPackages.name: Azur Seer — Intelligence-knot Spectacle
spellPackages.supportTool: Carian Regal Scepter +10 no-penalty/moon hard swap; Wing of Astel and Death's Poker remain visible weapon states
spellPackages.preFight: Magic-Shrouding + Intelligence-knot Physick raises INT 70→80 → select Comet Azur or Rellana's Twin Moons for a secured spectacle window.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Rellana's Twin Moons requires the Intelligence-knot bridge. Baseline audit excludes Azur Staff's 20% and Azur Crown's 15% FP penalties plus Comet Azur channel ticks; use Carian Regal when efficiency matters.

spellPackages.name: Dual Primeval Master
spellPackages.supportTool: Azur's Glintstone Staff +10 speed hard swap; Carian Regal Scepter +10 optional moon/no-penalty menu swap
spellPackages.preFight: Terra Magica only when stable → Magic-Shrouding + Cerulean Hidden Physick → choose Comet Azur, twin moons, or primeval-current pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Do not hold Lusat and Azur merely to accumulate penalties. Baseline audit excludes Lusat's 50% staff penalty, Lusat Crown's 15% global penalty, and Comet Azur channel ticks.

spellPackages.name: Supreme Generalist
spellPackages.supportTool: Staff of Loss +25 held for Night Comet; Lusat's Glintstone Staff +10 is a burst-only menu swap
spellPackages.preFight: Ranni's Dark Moon when useful → Staff of Loss Night Comet or encounter counter → Nebula/Ghostflame punish. Terra Magica and Bloodsucking are learned-window options.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Staff of Loss must be held for Night Comet. Lusat's 50% penalty applies only during the optional burst swap; gravity spells receive no Meteorite Staff bonus in the exact active loadout.

spellPackages.name: Moon-and-Stars Archmage
spellPackages.supportTool: Azur's Glintstone Staff +10 spectacle/speed hard swap; Wing of Astel and Death's Poker remain visible weapon states
spellPackages.preFight: Open with the moon matching the presentation or debuff goal → Founding Rain / Stars of Ruin pressure → Nebula or Ghostflame when a weapon-skill punish is safer.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Carian Regal supplies the 10% moon bonus without a staff FP penalty. Azur's staff is a deliberate speed/spectacle swap and raises FP costs by 20%; the three moon spells are not intended to be cast consecutively.

spellPackages.name: Erdtree Oathkeeper — Healing & Holy Control
spellPackages.supportTool: No passive-support seal in the exact Signature state; Euporia and Coded Sword remain separate weapon-skill states
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Holy/Opaline Physick → select healing, holy control, or matchup damage before returning to Euporia Vortex.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Golden Vow is the aura buff and stacks with regeneration. Minor Erdtree is a two-slot stationary field, not a rotation default. Black Flame and Pest-Thread Spears are matchup tools rather than identity transfers.

spellPackages.name: Flame-Art Templar — Fire & Resistance Coverage
spellPackages.supportTool: No specialist seal is counted in the active loadout; Flame Art Claymore and Coded Sword remain the weapon-skill states
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Flame, Grant Me Strength immediately before pressure → Flame/Opaline Physick → Flame Spear, Catch Flame, Giantsflame, or geometry-specific counters.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Grant Me Strength is the body buff and conflicts with defensive body buffs. Catch Flame receives no Giant's Seal school bonus. Giant's, Fire Knight's, and Godslayer's Seals remain later hard-swap research rather than active Phase 12C equipment.

spellPackages.name: Miquellan Sun Knight — Faith-knot Radiance
spellPackages.supportTool: Dryleaf Seal +25 held only for Multilayered Ring of Light; return to Erdtree Seal for Light of Miquella, Erdtree healing, and the golden-arc spells
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Holy/Faith-knot Physick raises Faith 70→80 → Light of Miquella during a secured window → golden rings/arcs → Euporia Vortex after luster.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Faith-knot is mandatory for Level-150 Light of Miquella. Dryleaf Seal boosts Multilayered Ring of Light but not Light of Miquella; Golden Arcs and Giant Golden Arc are Spiral incantations and receive no Dryleaf passive. Minor Erdtree consumes two slots.

spellPackages.name: Erdtree High Templar — Native Holy & Recovery
spellPackages.supportTool: No passive-support seal in the exact Signature state; Sacred Relic Sword and Euporia are separate native weapon-skill states
spellPackages.preFight: Blessing of the Erdtree → Golden Vow → Holy/Opaline Physick → Wave of Gold or native Light of Miquella → select healing, field sustain, or close control.
spellPackages.hardSwap: All requirements are native at 80 Faith. Golden Vow is the aura buff; Blessing is regeneration; direct and ranged heals remain reactive. Light of Miquella and Minor Erdtree each consume two slots and should not be treated as repeatable low-commitment fillers.

spellPackages.name: Supreme Faith Generalist — Fire, Black Flame & Physical
spellPackages.supportTool: No specialist seal is counted in the active state; Blasphemous Blade and Coded Sword remain the native weapon-skill channels
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Flame, Grant Me Strength → Flame/Bloodsucking Physick immediately before the learned pressure window → Taker's Flames or the package's best geometry/resistance answer.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Grant Me Strength is the body buff and cannot coexist with defensive body buffs. Bloodsucking is learned-fight only; use Opaline for first clears. Exact Giant's, Fire Knight's, and Godslayer's support-seal states remain deferred beyond this formal package.

spellPackages.name: Radiant Crusader — Golden Spectacle
spellPackages.supportTool: Dryleaf Seal +25 held only for Multilayered Ring of Light; use Erdtree Seal for Light of Miquella, Land of Shadow, healing, and Spiral golden arcs
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Holy/Opaline Physick → Light of Miquella or layered ring/arc pressure → Establish Order or Wave of Gold as the visible weapon-skill finish.
spellPackages.hardSwap: All requirements are native. Dryleaf Seal boosts Multilayered Ring of Light but not Light of Miquella; Golden Arcs and Giant Golden Arc receive no Dryleaf passive. Minor Erdtree and Light of Miquella each consume two slots.

spellPackages.name: Bloodfiend Ravager — Sustain & Blood Support
spellPackages.supportTool: The zero-weight seal is carried in the exact loadout; cast only during safe support windows, then return to the two-handed Bloodfiend's Arm.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality for attrition → choose Flame, Grant Me Strength for offense or one relevant fortification for defense → Spiked/Opaline Physick → two-hand Bloodfiend's Arm.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Grant Me Strength and all fortifications are mutually exclusive Body Buffs. Bloodflame Blade is omitted because the Blood-affinity arm and Occult hard swap cannot receive it. Blood-oath casts are situational, not a default rotation.

spellPackages.name: Occult Great Stars Reaper — Generalist Sustain
spellPackages.supportTool: The zero-weight seal remains available without changing the certified Great Stars / Star Fist active weight.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality before sustained pressure → choose Flame, Grant Me Strength or one relevant fortification → Thorny/Bloodsucking Physick → Wild Strikes or Endure pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Occult Great Stars and Occult Star Fist cannot receive Bloodflame Blade. Flame, Grant Me Strength conflicts with every fortification. Great Heal, cleanse, Pest Threads, and Catch Flame are reactive or geometry-specific tools.

spellPackages.name: Lord of Blood Vanguard — Blood Oath Utility
spellPackages.supportTool: The seal is the exact low-Faith support tool; Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear remains the visible default and Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear remains a menu swap.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality → Flame, Grant Me Strength → Flame/Opaline Physick → Bloodboon Ritual. Use Swarm, Bloodboon, or Talons only when spacing supports the cast.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Grant Me Strength conflicts with the three equipped fortifications. Blood-oath incantations reinforce the presentation but may not replace Bloodboon Ritual and spear pressure as the primary engine.

spellPackages.name: Ancient Sanguine Colossus — Colossal Support
spellPackages.supportTool: The zero-weight seal remains carried with the Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword; Icon Shield and Serpent-God sidearm remain separate menu swaps.
spellPackages.preFight: Choose Bestial Vitality or Crimsonburst regeneration, not both → select Flame, Grant Me Strength or one fortification → Stonebarb/Crimsonburst Physick → White Light Charge pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Bestial Vitality does not stack with Crimsonburst Crystal Tear. Flame, Grant Me Strength conflicts with every fortification. Swarm of Flies and Pest Threads are isolated ranged/geometry answers, not the core loop.

spellPackages.name: Eochaid Executioner — Multi-Hit Sustain
spellPackages.supportTool: The zero-weight seal is counted with Marais and Occult Great Stars; return immediately to the active weapon after any support cast.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality → choose Flame, Grant Me Strength or one fortification → Thorny/Bloodsucking Physick → Eochaid's Dancing Blade or Great Stars pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Grant Me Strength conflicts with the equipped fortifications. Bloodsucking and Rakshasa are learned-fight risks. Swarm, Talons, and Pest Threads remain matchup tools rather than a substitute for Eochaid multi-hit pressure.

spellPackages.name: Crimson Briar Tyrant — Blood & Shield Utility
spellPackages.supportTool: The zero-weight seal is carried beside the active cleaver/shield state; return to two-handed cleaver or Shield Crash immediately after casting.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality → choose Flame, Grant Me Strength or one fortification → Thorny/Opaline Physick → two-hand Wild Strikes or enter Shield Crash pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Grant Me Strength conflicts with the three fortifications. Bloodboon, Talons, and Swarm reinforce the briar/blood presentation but remain situational. Bloodflame Blade cannot buff either Occult armament.

spellPackages.name: Greatsword Juggernaut — Physical Support
spellPackages.supportTool: Return immediately to the two-handed Heavy Greatsword; the seal is not counted in the active-load audit.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality for long attrition → choose Flame, Grant Me Strength for offense or one relevant fortification for defense → drink the exact Physick → return to two-handed Greatsword pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Flame, Grant Me Strength and all four fortifications are mutually exclusive Body Buffs. Stone of Gurranq and Bestial Sling are pull, spacing, or stance-preservation tools—not a ranged casting loop. Great Heal is downtime/revenant utility rather than a flask replacement.

spellPackages.name: Giant-Crusher — Stance & Bestial Utility
spellPackages.supportTool: The seal replaces the active weapon only for a safe cast; re-equip and two-hand Giant-Crusher before engaging.
spellPackages.preFight: Choose Bestial Vitality for route attrition → choose Flame, Grant Me Strength or one relevant fortification → Spiked/Stonebarb Physick → use Giant-Crusher charged heavies and Royal Knight's Resolve as the real damage engine.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Body Buffs conflict. Stone of Gurranq, Beast Claw, and Gurranq's Beast Claw are physical geometry or stagger tools only; they may not displace charged-heavy, jump, or stance-break play. Great Heal is reactive downtime utility.

spellPackages.name: Troll Warlord — Bestial War-Rite
spellPackages.supportTool: The seal is already counted beside Troll's Hammer; return to the colossal weapon after each short utility cast.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality → Flame, Grant Me Strength when offense is preferred or Flame Fortification when fire defense is needed → Opaline/Stonebarb Physick → Troll's Roar and colossal melee.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Bestial casts reinforce the giant-warrior presentation but remain secondary to Troll's Hammer and Troll's Roar. Bestial Constitution is a frost/hemorrhage buildup cleanse. Great Heal is downtime/revenant utility. Flame, Grant Me Strength conflicts with Flame Fortification.

spellPackages.name: First Elden Lord — Roar & Bestial Support
spellPackages.supportTool: The seal is counted with Axe of Godfrey; Devonia's Hammer remains a separate menu hard swap.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality for attrition → choose Flame, Grant Me Strength or one relevant fortification → Spiked/Opaline Physick → Regal Roar and enhanced heavy attacks.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Body Buffs conflict. Heal from Afar is an emergency, ally, spirit, or revenant tool and is not a neutral self-heal. Stone and beast-claw casts are short physical utility; Regal Roar and colossal heavies remain the core rotation.

spellPackages.name: Verdigris Counter-Tank — Shield & Status Support
spellPackages.supportTool: Keep Verdigris Greatshield in the left hand, swap the right-hand Great Mace to the seal, cast Immutable Shield when appropriate, then return to Great Mace.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality when attrition matters → choose Flame, Grant Me Strength or one fortification → optionally cast Immutable Shield with the shield held left → Deflecting/Opaline Physick → guard-counter and Cragblade pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Immutable Shield is the only formal shield-buff exception and is native at INT 20 / FAI 19; it does not authorize a Golden Order damage package. Body Buffs remain mutually exclusive. Order Healing is Death Blight-only; Bestial Constitution handles frost/hemorrhage buildup.

spellPackages.name: Beast-Jaw Siege Tyrant — Bestial Siege Utility
spellPackages.supportTool: The seal is counted beside Fallingstar Beast Jaw; Prelate's Inferno Crozier remains a menu hard swap.
spellPackages.preFight: Bestial Vitality → choose Flame, Grant Me Strength for physical/fire pressure or Flame Fortification for defense → Opaline/Spiked Physick → colossal thrusts, Gravity Bolt, or Prelate's Charge hard swap.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Gravity Bolt remains an equipment skill, not a sorcery system. Beast-claw and Stone casts provide physical spacing or spectacle only. Order Healing and Bestial Constitution are narrow status tools. Flame, Grant Me Strength conflicts with Flame Fortification.

spellPackages.name: Royal Carian Knight — Sword & Shield
spellPackages.supportTool: Carian Knight's Shield +25 (No Skill default; Carian Retaliation shield skill remains a menu swap)
spellPackages.preFight: Scholar's Shield when the shield state is selected → Greatblade Phalanx or Magic Glintblade → enter with Carian Knight's Sword → chain Carian Slicer/Piercer/Greatsword around Carian Grandeur.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Carian Knight's Sword is fixed and cannot receive Scholar's Armament. Slot 7 is the Carian Retaliation sorcery; the shield skill is a separate menu swap. Carian Retaliation and active phalanx blades can replace one another, so do not overlap them.

spellPackages.name: Phalanx Counterblade — Enchanted Milady
spellPackages.supportTool: Wolf Crest Shield +25 (No Skill; optional left-hand defensive state)
spellPackages.preFight: Scholar's Armament on the exact Keen Milady → Greatblade Phalanx / Magic Glintblade / Glintblade Trio setup → thrust-counter entry → Impaling Thrust, Slicer, Piercer, or Greatsword follow-through.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Scholar's Armament is legal only on the exact Keen Milady and is illegal after any Magic or Cold conversion. Scholar's Shield can coexist with the weapon buff because it enchants a different object, but the staff/weapon/shield hand transitions must remain deliberate.

spellPackages.name: Enchanted Academy Duelist
spellPackages.supportTool: No shield; Keen Rogier's Rapier remains the immediate melee state
spellPackages.preFight: Scholar's Armament on the exact Keen Rogier's Rapier → delayed glintblade or phalanx setup → Piercing Fang / counterthrust pressure → Slicer, Piercer, or Greatsword transition; Miriam's Vanishing is a reposition, not a ranged loop.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Scholar's Armament is legal only while Rogier's Rapier remains Keen. The Carian Glintblade Staff boosts delayed glintblade and phalanx sorceries; it does not authorize passive staff-first play or a frost/moonlight package.

spellPackages.name: Carian Sovereign Spellknight
spellPackages.supportTool: No shield; Magic Milady +25 remains the active melee state
spellPackages.preFight: Greatblade Phalanx / Magic Glintblade / Glintblade Trio setup → Magic Milady entry → Carian Sovereignty punish → Slicer, Piercer, Greatsword, Spiral, or Vanishing transition according to range.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Magic Milady cannot receive Scholar's Armament. Carian Regal Scepter is used as a generalist catalyst rather than a moon-sorcery package; no frostbite, Dark Moon, or stationary artillery rotation is authorized.

spellPackages.name: Grandmaster Magic Duelist
spellPackages.supportTool: No shield; Moonveil +10 remains the active melee and skill-pressure state
spellPackages.preFight: Delayed glintblade/phalanx setup → Moonveil pressure and counterpunish → Slicer/Piercer/Greatsword at close range → Shard Spiral or one Comet only when the target creates a practical mid-range window.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Moonveil is fixed and cannot receive Scholar's Armament. Comet is one direct mid-range answer, not a Primeval Archmage rotation; Night Comet, Staff of Loss, Terra Magica, and beam-caster sequencing remain excluded.

spellPackages.name: Silver Mirror Royal Guard
spellPackages.supportTool: Silver Mirrorshield +10 (No Skill); Carian Regal Scepter +10 remains a menu hard swap excluded from active load
spellPackages.preFight: Scholar's Shield with Silver Mirrorshield held left → Greatblade Phalanx or Magic Glintblade → guarded thrust / guard counter / Impaling Thrust → cast through the Carian Sorcery Sword with heavy inputs → Slicer/Piercer punish.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Carian Sorcery Sword is fixed and cannot receive Scholar's Armament. Scholar's Shield requires the shield in the left hand. Slot 2 is the Carian Retaliation sorcery; active retaliation blades and phalanx blades can replace one another.

spellPackages.name: Land of Reeds Swordmaster — Field Kit
spellPackages.supportTool: Longbow +25 / Mighty Shot remains secondary utility
spellPackages.preFight: Two-handed katana normals → running or charged punish → heavy Unsheathe only on confirmed recovery → Mighty Shot only to pull, pursue, or finish → choose legal consumable/tool support without replacing melee.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Dragonwound Grease is legal only on the exact Keen Nagakiba. Exalted Flesh and other body-buff consumables are encounter choices, not simultaneous defaults. Bow use remains secondary; exact quantities and flask/FP budgets are Phase 16D.

spellPackages.name: Keen Great-Katana Breaker — Stance Kit
spellPackages.supportTool: Estoc +25 / Impaling Thrust remains a menu hard swap
spellPackages.preFight: Cragblade before engagement → great-katana normals, running thrusts, charged heavies, and feints → stance break/critical → Impaling Thrust hard swap only for precise pierce or guarded-target matchups.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Cragblade is a weapon buff and cannot coexist with weapon greases on the active Great Katana. Estoc is a menu hard swap. Exalted Flesh and stamina support are optional encounter choices; pots never replace the two-handed melee loop. Resources remain Phase 16D.

spellPackages.name: White-Reed Counterguard — Defensive Kit
spellPackages.supportTool: Banished Knight's Shield +25 / No Skill; Buckler Parry is a menu swap
spellPackages.preFight: Space or block actively → guard/thrust counter → critical conversion → heavy Unsheathe only on earned recovery → Buckler Parry as a deliberate menu swap → use tools for control or recovery, never passive turtling.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Shield Grease applies to the exact standard medium shield, not the Keen Uchigatana. No Skill preserves Unsheathe. Boiled Crab is a body-buff choice; Sleep Pots and Fan Daggers are tactical control/finish tools, not a ranged-first loop. Quantities remain Phase 16D.

spellPackages.name: Malenian Blade Master — Capstone Kit
spellPackages.supportTool: Ansbach's Longbow +10 / Fan Shot remains secondary utility
spellPackages.preFight: Katana normals and running pressure → charged or jumping punish → Waterfowl only on a confirmed extended opening, group, or staggered target → Fan Shot only for pull, pursuit, weak-point burst, or finish.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Hand of Malenia cannot receive greases. Waterfowl and Fan Shot share the native FP reserve but cannot become the neutral loop. Bloodboil and Uplifting Aromatics are risk/safety alternatives selected for the encounter; exact quantities and arrow budgets are Phase 16D.

spellPackages.name: Rakshasa Great-Katana Pressure — Breaker Kit
spellPackages.supportTool: Keen Great Katana +25 / Piercing Fang remains a menu hard swap
spellPackages.preFight: Running/thrusting normals → charged heavy or feint → stance break → one Weed Cutter input only when commitment is safe → Piercing Fang hard swap for full guard bypass or long-lunge punishment.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Rakshasa's Great Katana cannot receive greases. Bloodboil is learned-fight risk and may be replaced by a defensive choice later. Pots support stance/control only; they never replace the great-katana default. Quantities and resources remain Phase 16D.

spellPackages.name: Swordhand Counter-Duelist — Night Kit
spellPackages.supportTool: Black Leather Shield +25 / No Skill and Black Bow +10 / Barrage are active support states
spellPackages.preFight: Sword of Night normals → double-hit charged heavy or guard counter → Deflecting Guard when selected → Witching Hour Slash only on an earned opening → Barrage only to pull, pursue, interrupt, or finish.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Sword of Night cannot receive greases. No Skill preserves the sword skill. Boiled Crab is a body-buff choice; Sleep Pot and Fan Daggers are tactical tools. Bow pressure is secondary and cannot convert the parent into Shadow Marksman. Resources remain Phase 16D.

spellPackages.name: Fundamentalist Sword-and-Shield Scholar — Ten-Slot Doctrine
spellPackages.primaryTool: Golden Order Seal +10; Staff of the Great Beyond +10 menu hard swap for sorceries
spellPackages.supportTool: Beast Crest Heater Shield +25; staff replaces the right-hand sword only while preparing shield/phalanx sorcery
spellPackages.preFight: Regression only before the buff sequence when a reset is required → Golden Vow → Blessing’s Boon → encounter fortification → staff hard swap for Scholar’s Shield and Greatblade Phalanx → return to Sword of Night and Flame / shield → Discus and Triple Rings for pressure → Radagon’s Rings only on a confirmed punish.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Law of Regression dispels the package’s own buffs and shield enchantment, so it is never cast after setup unless an intentional full reset is required. Scholar’s Shield requires the staff and active left shield and cannot coexist with Shield Grease or Immutable Shield. Barrier of Gold is the selected body fortification, not a universal default.

spellPackages.name: Great Beyond Ring Engine — Ten-Slot Hybrid
spellPackages.primaryTool: Staff of the Great Beyond +10 for sorceries and rapid hybrid casting; Golden Order Seal +10 for Fundamentalist ring/law scaling and passive support
spellPackages.supportTool: Magic Noble’s Slender Sword / Square Off; no active shield
spellPackages.preFight: Regression before all buffs if needed → Golden Vow → Golden Order Seal for Discus, Triple Rings, and Radagon’s Rings → Staff of the Great Beyond for Magic Glintblade, Greatblade Phalanx, Shard Spiral, Rock Sling, and Eternal Darkness → convert delayed pressure into Square Off or physical normals.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Regression clears Golden Vow and all other active effects. Greatblade Phalanx is the only phalanx state. Rock Sling is a compact physical fallback, not Gravity Gladiator ownership; Eternal Darkness is reactive anti-caster utility, not a staff-first neutral loop.

spellPackages.name: Radiant Law Knight — Ten-Slot Light Doctrine
spellPackages.primaryTool: Golden Order Seal +10; Dryleaf Seal +25 menu support for ring-of-light emphasis
spellPackages.supportTool: Blue-Gold Kite Shield +25; Miquellan Knight’s Sword +10 / Sacred Blade
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → Blessing’s Boon → choose Law of Causality only for a deliberate reactive state → Discus for routine pressure → Triple Rings for spread/return paths → Multilayered Ring for sustained contact → Radagon’s Rings for committed area punishment → Litany or Order Healing only for their anti-undead/death-blight jobs → shield counter or Sacred Blade melee conversion.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Law of Causality is situational and must not be treated as a permanent default or stacked blindly with encounter body fortifications. Dryleaf support is a menu state. Order Healing cures death-blight buildup but does not restore HP. No Death sorcery, ghostflame, or pure-Faith Erdtree package is inherited.

spellPackages.name: Golden Order Greatsword Hierophant — Ten-Slot Doctrine
spellPackages.primaryTool: Golden Order Seal +10; Dryleaf Seal +25 menu support for selected rings
spellPackages.supportTool: Golden Order Greatsword +10 two-handed default; Brass Shield is a separate menu state
spellPackages.preFight: Regression only as a pre-setup reset → Golden Vow → Blessing’s Boon → choose either Law of Causality or Lord’s Divine Fortification for the encounter → Establish Order / two-handed greatsword pressure → Discus and Triple Rings between melee entries → Multilayered Ring against sustained openings → Radagon’s Rings on confirmed area punish → Order Healing only for death-blight buildup.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Law of Causality and Lord’s Divine Fortification are mutually exclusive body-buff choices, not simultaneous defaults. Regression removes both and also removes Golden Vow/regeneration. The two-handed greatsword and menu shield are never represented as simultaneous active equipment.

spellPackages.name: Regression Battlemage — Ten-Slot Hybrid
spellPackages.primaryTool: Golden Order Seal +10 for Fundamentalist rings/law; Staff of the Great Beyond +10 for sorceries and rapid hybrid transitions
spellPackages.supportTool: Sword of Night and Flame +10; Brass Shield +25 / No Skill active
spellPackages.preFight: Regression before setup only → Golden Vow → staff cast Scholar’s Shield on the active Brass Shield → Greatblade Phalanx → Golden Order Seal ring pressure → Shard Spiral for large-body magic, Rock Sling for physical/stance fallback, and Gavel of Haima for close conversion → shield counter or Night-and-Flame Stance after the spell-created opening.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Regression clears Golden Vow and Scholar’s Shield. Scholar’s Shield requires the active Brass Shield and cannot coexist with Shield Grease or Immutable Shield. Greatblade Phalanx is the only phalanx state. Sorceries remain compact fallback/transition tools rather than Primeval, Carian, or Gravity ownership.

spellPackages.name: Perfect Order High Paladin — Ten-Slot Light Doctrine
