spellPackages.primaryTool: Golden Order Seal +10; Dryleaf Seal +25 held or menu-supported for light-ring pressure
spellPackages.supportTool: Inseparable Sword +10 two-handed default; Banished Knight’s Shield +25 is a separate menu state
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow → choose Law of Causality only for a deliberate reactive state → Discus and Triple Rings to establish spacing → Multilayered Ring for sustained holy contact → Radagon’s Rings for the committed punish → Litany against Those Who Live in Death → Order Healing for death-blight buildup → enter the separate shield state before Immutable Shield → otherwise return to two-handed Inseparable Sword pressure.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Immutable Shield requires the menu shield state and cannot be active while the Inseparable Sword is represented as two-handed. It also conflicts with Scholar’s Shield and Shield Grease. Law of Causality remains a situational body-buff choice. No Death sorcery, ghostflame, moon, frost, or Erdtree pure-Faith package is installed.

spellPackages.name: Shadow Hunter — Mobile Field Quiver
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact bow/dagger ammunition package
spellPackages.supportTool: Pulley Bow +10 / Mighty Shot remains a menu hard swap using the same arrow reserve
spellPackages.preFight: Open with Arrow or Stormwing Bone Arrow and manual weak-point shots → use Fan Shot only for a confirmed burst, group, pursuit, or status window → choose one target-efficient bleed, poison, frost, or premium sleep route → use Firebone only for a justified elemental matchup or post-frost reset → Quickstep into Misericorde backstab/critical/finisher when distance collapses → disengage and restore ranged control.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Ansbach's Longbow and Pulley Bow use arrows; Misericorde is the close-range conversion tool. Sleepbone ammunition is premium and never routine. Status choices are alternatives, not a requirement to cycle every type. Physical Arrow and Stormwing remain the fallback. Exact counts, FP bars, and crafting reserves remain Phase 18D.

spellPackages.name: Rapid-Proc Marksman — Split Quiver
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact bow/crossbow/knife ammunition package
spellPackages.supportTool: Black Bow +10 / Barrage and Pulley Crossbow +10 are simultaneous active ranged states
spellPackages.preFight: Arrow or Stormwing establishes the physical baseline → select one arrow status and apply it with mobile shots or Barrage → use Pulley Crossbow only when its three-bolt discharge materially improves buildup or interruption → reserve Black-Key Bolts for long-lived rot-susceptible targets → Bloodhound's Step creates the Great Knife breach/finisher window → reset to bow range immediately after the close exchange.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Black Bow accepts arrows and Pulley Crossbow accepts bolts. Barrage and the three-bolt crossbow magnify ammunition consumption, so no status is fired indiscriminately. Black-Key Bolts are premium. Great Knife remains a physical transition weapon; it does not convert the parent into dagger-first melee. Exact stacks and repeat-use arithmetic remain Phase 18D.

spellPackages.name: Night Infiltrator — Silent Kill Quiver
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact stealth bow/crossbow/dagger package
spellPackages.supportTool: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow +10 remains a menu hard swap for a deliberate premium rot shot
spellPackages.preFight: Approach under Concealing Veil and Black Knife silence → open with a charged Arrow or Stormwing weak-point shot → use sleep, poison, or bleed only when the control/proc creates a superior assassination window → Mighty Shot punishes unaware or stationary targets → a deliberate Black-Key Bolt may establish rot on a long encounter → Quickstep to Misericorde backstab or critical → break contact rather than trade.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Pulley Bow uses arrows; Crepus's crossbow uses bolts and remains a menu hard swap. Sleepbone and Black-Key ammunition are premium reserves, not routine exploration stock. The package preserves stealth and physical precision even when status is resisted. Exact ammunition quantities and reserves remain Phase 18D.

spellPackages.name: Master Arsenal Hunter — Grand Arsenal Quiver
spellPackages.supportTool: Ansbach's Longbow and Greatbow are active; Jar Cannon remains a two-handed menu artillery swap
spellPackages.preFight: Use Arrow or Stormwing for mobile neutral control → use Bloodbone or Coldbone only when the target rewards buildup → switch to Great Arrow for ordinary artillery, Golem's Great Arrow for premium impact, or Radahn's Spear for the Lion Greatbow-compatible reserve state → select Ballista Bolt or Explosive Greatbolt only for siege, range, or burst value → Fan Shot controls mobile pressure and Through and Through owns committed artillery windows → Misericorde/Quickstep converts the stagger or close breach.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Each ammunition family is weapon-specific: arrows for Ansbach, greatarrows for Greatbow, and greatbolts for Jar Cannon. Greatbow and ballista shots are deliberate, high-recovery artillery rather than the neutral loop. Golem arrows, Radahn spears, and explosive greatbolts are premium. Exact stacks and resource arithmetic remain Phase 18D.

spellPackages.name: Status Executioner — Adaptive Status Quiver
slots: Barrage → Poison Antspur / Poison Mist Conversion
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact bow/crossbow/Antspur status package
spellPackages.supportTool: Black Bow +10 and Pulley Crossbow +10 deliver ranged status; Poison Antspur / Poison Mist handles close conversion
spellPackages.preFight: Begin with Arrow when status value is uncertain → choose exactly one opening route: bleed, poison, rot, frost, or sleep → use Barrage for arrow buildup and Pulley Crossbow for bolt burst only when the target and stock justify it → establish rot early on a long fight, poison when damage-over-time will run, frost for burst/vulnerability, or sleep for a high-value control window → use Firebone only after frostbite when a reset is deliberately profitable → Poison Mist/Antspur converts a breach → return to physical arrows when status is inefficient or immune.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Arcane 20 does not universally increase these arrow/bolt buildups on Black Bow or Pulley Crossbow. It supports the qualifying Poison-affinity Antspur poison buildup; Antspur's scarlet-rot buildup remains fixed/non-Arcane. Rot and sleep ammunition are premium. Kindred of Rot triggers only from nearby poison/rot events and never justifies wasting stock. Exact counts remain Phase 18D.

spellPackages.name: Phantom Marksman — Mobile Night Quiver
slots: Claws of Night Thrown Strong Attack
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact mobile bow/thrown-claw package
spellPackages.supportTool: Ansbach's Longbow +10 and Claws of Night +10 are the certified fast-roll state
spellPackages.preFight: Maintain fast-roll spacing with Arrow or Stormwing → use Bloodbone, Coldbone, Lightningbone, or premium Sleepbone only for a target-specific advantage → Fan Shot punishes pursuit, groups, and weak-point windows → use the Claws thrown strong attack or Scattershot Throw when the enemy crosses bow distance → flow into a short melee string only when safe → fast-roll out and restore bow control before the claws become the neutral plan.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Claws of Night consume no arrow stock for thrown strong attacks but still remain a transition tool. Sleepbone is premium. Bleed from arrows or claws is supplementary and does not create Vampire sustain. The fast-roll state replaces poise trading with repositioning; exact stocks, FP bars, and quantities remain Phase 18D.

spellPackages.name: Crimson Reed Ronin — Blood Pursuit Kit
slots: Bloody Helice / Dynast's Finesse Counter Swap
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact non-casting martial/status package
spellPackages.supportTool: Blood Wakizashi / Quickstep is active; Bloody Helice / Dynast's Finesse remains a menu hard swap
spellPackages.preFight: Occult Nagakiba owns neutral: normal and running thrust pressure → charged or jumping punish → Double Slash only on a confirmed opening → Wakizashi pursuit and Quickstep reset when the fight compresses → Bloody Helice hard swap only for a deliberate evasive-counter matchup → choose at most one auxiliary status tool and return to the Occult physical baseline whenever status value is poor.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Blood and Occult affinities cannot be coated with greases. Poison and frost tools are matchup alternatives rather than a requirement to stack every status. Kukri is pursuit/finish utility, not a Shadow Marksman loop. Bloody Helice is a menu state and never counted simultaneously with the certified active load. Exact carried quantities, flask split, FP reserve, crafting floor, and repeat-use arithmetic remain Phase 19D.

spellPackages.name: Bloodstorm Pursuer — Rapid Hemorrhage Kit
slots: Rivers of Blood Normal / Running Pressure
Sacred Bloody Flesh — Optional Blood-Risk Buff
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact non-casting martial/status package
spellPackages.supportTool: Rivers of Blood and Occult Uchigatana are active; Occult Star Fist / Cragblade remains a menu strike-and-stance swap
spellPackages.preFight: Open with ordinary katana pressure and confirm target susceptibility → Corpse Piler only inside a real punish or pursuit window → use Seppuku on the Occult Uchigatana only when the setup time and HP cost are justified → if bleed is inefficient, stop proc-chasing immediately and use Occult Uchigatana normals or the Star Fist / Cragblade strike-and-stance hard swap → select a single auxiliary control/status tool rather than cycling stock.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Seppuku applies only to the equipped Uchigatana state and costs HP; it never modifies Rivers of Blood. Cragblade belongs to the Star Fist hard swap, not either active katana. Bloodsucking Physick and Sacred Bloody Flesh are learned-fight risk choices, not mandatory first-clear assumptions. Rot/frost tools are alternatives. Exact quantities and resource arithmetic remain Phase 19D.

spellPackages.name: Sanguine Noble Duelist — Fast-Roll Blood Kit
slots: Bloody Helice / Dynast's Finesse Counter Swap
Reduvia / Reduvia Blood Blade Close Finisher
Boiled Crab — Optional Safety Body Buff
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact non-casting fast-roll martial/status package
spellPackages.supportTool: Blood Uchigatana is the certified active state; Bloody Helice and Reduvia are deliberate menu hard swaps
spellPackages.preFight: Blood Uchigatana normal and running pressure → fast-roll reposition → Bloody Slash only on a confirmed spacing punish → Bloody Helice / Dynast's Finesse hard swap when an evasive counter is the superior answer → Reduvia only as a close finisher or short pressure bridge → select sleep or frost only for a target-specific advantage → reset rather than trade.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Bloody Slash costs both FP and HP. Reduvia Blood Blade is a close-range/finisher utility and cannot become ranged status application. Bloody Helice and Reduvia are mutually exclusive menu states outside the certified active katana load. Boiled Crab is an optional body-buff choice. Exact quantities and repeat-use resources remain Phase 19D.

spellPackages.name: Cursed-Blood Swordmaster — Great-Katana Master Kit
slots: Rivers of Blood / Corpse Piler Pursuit
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact non-casting great-katana/blood/status package
spellPackages.supportTool: Occult Great Katana and Rivers of Blood are active; Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana / Dragonwound Slash is a menu specialist swap
spellPackages.preFight: Occult Great Katana normal, running-thrust, charged and jumping pressure establishes the physical baseline → use Overhead Stance light or strong follow-up for committed stance/status windows → Rivers of Blood handles fast pursuit and Hemorrhage burst when appropriate → Dragon-Hunter hard swap only for a justified dragon matchup → status tools remain optional; physical and stance damage remain fully functional against bleed immunity.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Rivers of Blood is a reserve pressure state, not the neutral owner. Dragonwound Slash is a specialist hard swap and its charged wave does not convert the archetype to ranged play. Bloodboil Aromatic is a learned-fight risk body buff and cannot coexist with another body-buff choice. Rot/frost are target-specific alternatives. Exact quantities and resource arithmetic remain Phase 19D.

spellPackages.name: Hemorrhage Executioner — Maximum Pressure Kit
slots: Sacred Bloody Flesh — Optional Blood-Risk Buff
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact non-casting martial/status package
spellPackages.supportTool: Blood Nagakiba and Occult Uchigatana are active; Occult Star Fist / Cragblade remains the menu strike-and-stance fallback
spellPackages.preFight: Blood Nagakiba running and normal pressure → Double Slash only while the target is committed → Occult Uchigatana ordinary physical pressure and Seppuku as a deliberate setup state → use Star Fist charged heavies and Cragblade as the immediate strike/stance pivot when slash or bleed underperforms → keep one auxiliary control tool and preserve melee pursuit.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Seppuku and its self-damage belong only to the Uchigatana state. Cragblade belongs only to the Star Fist hard swap. Sacred Bloody Flesh and Bloodsucking are optional risk amplifiers rather than mandatory defaults. Fan Daggers are a finish/pursuit tool only. Exact quantities, reserves, and farming policy remain Phase 19D.

spellPackages.name: Violet Reed Exile — Defined Multi-Status Katana Kit
slots: Obsidian Lamina / Dynastic Sickleplay Blood Swap
Poleblade of the Bud / Romina's Purification Rot Swap
Fire Pot — Deliberate Frost Reset Only
spellPackages.primaryTool: No catalyst — exact non-casting poison/lightning/frost/blood/rot specialist package
spellPackages.supportTool: Serpentbone Blade and Dragonscale Blade are active; Obsidian Lamina and Poleblade of the Bud are separate menu specialist swaps
spellPackages.preFight: Serpentbone Blade normal, unique heavy and native Double Slash pressure establishes deadly poison when useful → Dragonscale Blade is the physical/Lightning/Frost specialist state through Ice Lightning Sword → Obsidian Lamina is the native Dexterity/Arcane blood-evasion swap → Poleblade of the Bud is the rot specialist → use fire only for a deliberate post-frost reset and sleep only for a high-value control window → return to katana neutral instead of cycling every status.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Serpentbone poison and Dragonscale frost do not scale with Arcane; Arcane remains justified by the separate native Dexterity/Arcane blood/rot weapons. Fire can erase Frostbite and is therefore prohibited until a deliberate reset is profitable. Romina's Purification and Dynastic Sickleplay require menu swaps. Status routes are alternatives, not a simultaneous rotation. Exact stock and resource arithmetic remain Phase 19D.

spellPackages.name: Gransax Stormlancer — Ten-Slot Dragon Cult Punish Doctrine
spellPackages.supportTool: Bolt of Gransax +10 and Gravel Stone Seal are active; Keen Guardian's Swordspear is a menu hard swap and is the only weapon in this state eligible for Electrify Armament
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow before engagement when the cost is justified → Bolt of Gransax spear pressure owns neutral → Honed Bolt or Lightning Spear for short punish windows → Knight's Lightning Spear for a stronger confirmed projectile punish → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear for close red-lightning conversion → Lansseax's Glaive for a safe sweep/crowd opening → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike only for large bodies or long recovery → Frozen Lightning Spear for a target-specific frost/lightning window → if the Keen Guardian's Swordspear hard swap is chosen, cast Electrify Armament before melee entry → Electrocharge is an optional aggressive body-buff state → immediately return to melee after every cast.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Electrify Armament is legal only on the Keen Guardian's Swordspear hard swap, never on Bolt of Gransax. Electrocharge is a Body Buff and cannot coexist with another Body Buff. Golden Vow is an Aura Buff and may coexist with one chosen Body Buff. No spell grants permission to stand at range and spam; every offensive cast requires an earned punish window. Exact flask split, repeat-use reserve and carried consumables remain Phase 20D.

spellPackages.name: Thunder Swordspear — Ten-Slot Efficiency Doctrine
spellPackages.supportTool: Lightning Guardian's Swordspear / Blinkbolt is active; Keen Godskin Stitcher / Piercing Fang is a menu hard swap and the only weapon in this state eligible for Electrify Armament
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow when efficient → Lightning Swordspear running/jump pressure and Blinkbolt re-entry own neutral → Honed Bolt or Lightning Spear for short openings → Knight's Lightning Spear for the premier projectile punish → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear for close conversion → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike for large/locked targets → Frozen Lightning Spear for frost-susceptible targets → use the Keen Godskin Stitcher hard swap with Electrify Armament when split lightning damage is inefficient → Electrocharge is the offensive body-buff choice; Golden Lightning Fortification replaces it against serious incoming lightning → return to melee immediately.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Lightning affinity cannot receive Electrify Armament, so the spell is reserved for the Keen Stitcher menu state. Electrocharge and Golden Lightning Fortification are mutually exclusive Body Buffs. Golden Vow remains an Aura Buff. The three Death Knight armor pieces amplify the accepted storm package but do not transfer Death Knight family ownership. Exact resource arithmetic remains Phase 20D.

spellPackages.name: Dragon-Cult Duelist — Ten-Slot Mobile Storm Doctrine
spellPackages.supportTool: Lightning Milady / Wing Stance is active; Lightning Backhand Blade / Blinkbolt is a menu mobility state; neither weapon is eligible for Electrify Armament
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow when desired → choose Electrocharge for aggressive proximity damage OR Dragonbolt Blessing for deflection/status resistance, never both → Milady flowing chains, Wing Stance and leaping thrusts own neutral → Honed Bolt and Lightning Spear take the shortest cast windows → Knight's Lightning Spear takes stronger projectile windows → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear and Lansseax's Glaive are close red-lightning conversions → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike is reserved for a genuine long/large-target punish → Frozen Lightning Spear is a specialist frost/lightning tool → return to Milady immediately.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Electrocharge and Dragonbolt Blessing are mutually exclusive Body Buffs. Dragonbolt Blessing lowers Lightning Damage Negation, so it is not a universal default. Lightning-affinity Milady and Backhand Blade cannot receive weapon-buff incantations. Golden Vow is the only generic aura in this Level-150 Fashion package. No Dragon Communion, Arcane, katana-primary or caster-first behavior is authorized.

spellPackages.name: Dragon King's Champion — Ten-Slot Ancient Dragon Doctrine
spellPackages.supportTool: Dragon King's Cragblade / Thundercloud Form is active; Bolt of Gransax is a menu specialist reserve; neither native lightning weapon is eligible for Electrify Armament
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow when efficient → optional Electrocharge body state → Cragblade running-heavy, pierce-counter and Thundercloud pressure owns neutral → Honed Bolt or Lightning Spear for short punish windows → Knight's Lightning Spear for the premier projectile punish → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear for close red conversion → Lansseax's Glaive for a broad safe opening → Fortissax's Lightning Spear for a committed red-lightning finisher → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike only for large bodies/long recovery → Frozen Lightning Spear for specialist frost pressure → immediate Cragblade re-entry.
spellPackages.hardSwap: No weapon-buff spell is carried because both exact Signature weapon states are fixed native lightning weapons. Fortissax, Lansseax and Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike are high-commitment casts and are prohibited in neutral. Electrocharge is one optional Body Buff and Golden Vow is the Aura Buff. Bolt of Gransax remains a menu specialist, not the package's ranged neutral owner.

spellPackages.name: Storm Executioner — Ten-Slot Maximum-Conversion Doctrine
spellPackages.supportTool: Lightning Godskin Stitcher / Lightning Slash is active; Keen Guardian's Swordspear / Sword Dance is a menu hard swap and the only weapon in this state eligible for Electrify Armament
spellPackages.preFight: Golden Vow when efficient → optional Electrocharge → Lightning Stitcher running-thrust, counter and charged-heavy pressure plus Lightning Slash own neutral → Honed Bolt or Lightning Spear for short openings → Knight's Lightning Spear for efficient ranged punish → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear for close conversion → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike for large-body burst → Fortissax's Lightning Spear only on a committed punish → Frozen Lightning Spear for frost-susceptible targets → against high lightning resistance, hard swap to Keen Guardian's Swordspear, apply Electrify Armament only when lightning weapon damage remains worthwhile, or simply use the Keen physical baseline → return to melee.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Electrify Armament cannot buff the active Lightning-affinity Stitcher and belongs only to the Keen Swordspear menu state. Electrocharge is a Body Buff; Golden Vow is an Aura Buff. Bloodsucking Physick is already an accepted Phase 20B learned-fight risk state and Phase 20C adds no additional body-buff stacking assumptions. Three Death Knight pieces remain partial optimization only.

spellPackages.name: Red Lightning Ascendant — Ten-Slot Ancient-Dragon Display Doctrine
spellPackages.supportTool: Lightning Milady / Wing Stance is active; Lightning Backhand Blade / Blinkbolt is a menu mobility state; neither state is weapon-buff eligible
spellPackages.preFight: Choose exactly one Aura Buff: Golden Vow for superior general offense/defense OR Dragonbolt of Florissax for the red-lightning support identity → choose exactly one Body Buff when appropriate: Electrocharge for aggressive proximity damage OR Dragonbolt Blessing for deflection/status resistance → Milady/Wing Stance owns neutral → Honed Bolt and Knight's Lightning Spear handle practical short/medium punish windows → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear and Lansseax's Glaive convert close openings → Fortissax's Lightning Spear is the dramatic committed finisher → Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike is restricted to large-body/long-recovery punishment → immediately resume melee.
spellPackages.hardSwap: Golden Vow and Dragonbolt of Florissax are mutually exclusive Aura Buffs. Electrocharge and Dragonbolt Blessing are mutually exclusive Body Buffs. Dragonbolt Blessing lowers Lightning Damage Negation. No Electrify Armament or Vyke's Dragonbolt is carried because both accepted weapons are Lightning affinity. Death Lightning remains a reserve/rejected formal-package candidate because its two-slot cost and Death Blight role do not justify displacing practical melee-caster tools.
